library(CanadaForestAllometry)

library(patchwork)
```

# Site index models included in the package

Models are grouped by function, with separate subsections for registered
variants. Curve labels give the site-index levels used with each variant.
Additional predictors and illustrative scenarios are stated where required;
they are not defaults supplied by the model functions.

```{r}
#| label: si-model-sections
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| results: asis

plot_si_curves <- function(
  model_row,
  si_values = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25),
  age_min = 1,
  age_max = 150,
  age_by = 1,
  subregion = "All",
  climate = NULL,
  facet_ncol = 4
) {
  model_name <- model_row$engine[[1]]
  model_fun <- get(model_name, mode = "function")
  supports_predict_height <- model_row$supports_predict_height[[1]]
  species_vec <- model_row$species[[1]]
  age_basis <- model_row$age_basis[[1]]
  age_domain_max <- model_row$age_domain_max[[1]]
  plot_si_values <- model_row$plot_si_values[[1]]
  x_axis_label <- switch(
    age_basis,
    total_age = "Total age (years)",
    breast_height_age = "Breast-height age (years)",
    "Age (years)"
  )

  if (!isTRUE(supports_predict_height) || isTRUE(model_row$requires_gi[[1]])) {
    p <- ggplot2::ggplot() +
      ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Height curve not available for this model") +
      ggplot2::xlim(0, 1) +
      ggplot2::ylim(0, 1) +
      ggplot2::theme_void() +
      ggplot2::ggtitle(paste0(model_name, "()"))
    return(list(plot = p, n_rows = 1L, n_species = 0L))
  }

  call_fixed <- model_row$fixed_args[[1]]

  if (!is.na(age_domain_max)) {
    age_max <- min(age_max, age_domain_max)
  }
  if (!is.null(plot_si_values)) {
    si_values <- plot_si_values
  }

  ages <- seq(age_min, age_max, by = age_by)
  grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(
    species = species_vec,
    si = si_values,
    age = ages
  )
  if (!is.null(climate)) {
    grid <- dplyr::left_join(grid, climate, by = dplyr::join_by(species))
    climate_args <- c("MAP", "MWMT", "MAP_normal", "MWMT_normal")
    if (anyNA(grid[climate_args])) {
      stop("Climate scenario must supply all four inputs for every plotted species.")
    }
  } else {
    climate_args <- character()
  }

  prediction_errors <- character()
  pred_one <- function(i) {
    args <- c(
      list(age = grid$age[[i]], si = grid$si[[i]]),
      if ("species" %in% names(formals(model_fun))) list(species = grid$species[[i]]) else list(),
      if ("natural_subregion" %in% names(formals(model_fun))) list(natural_subregion = subregion) else list(),
      call_fixed,
      as.list(grid[i, climate_args, drop = FALSE])
    )
    out <- tryCatch(
      do.call(model_fun, args),
      error = function(e) {
        prediction_errors <<- unique(c(prediction_errors, conditionMessage(e)))
        NULL
      }
    )
    if (is.null(out) || !"height" %in% names(out)) return(NA_real_)
    as.numeric(out$height[[1]])
  }

  grid$height <- vapply(
    seq_len(nrow(grid)),
    pred_one,
    numeric(1)
  )

  plot_data <- grid |>
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(.data$height)) |>
    dplyr::mutate(si = factor(.data$si, levels = sort(unique(si_values))))

  if (nrow(plot_data) == 0L) {
    stop(sprintf(
      "No height predictions for %s: %s",
      model_row$model_id[[1]], paste(prediction_errors, collapse = "; ")
    ))
  }
  if (length(prediction_errors)) {
    cat(
      "**Some curve points were omitted after prediction errors:** ",
      paste(prediction_errors, collapse = "; "), "\n\n", sep = ""
    )
  }
  label_data <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$species, .data$si) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$age == max(.data$age, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
    dplyr::slice_tail(n = 1) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  n_species <- length(species_vec)
  n_rows <- max(1L, ceiling(n_species / facet_ncol))
  n_panels <- n_rows * facet_ncol

  species_plots <- lapply(species_vec, function(sp) {
    df_sp <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$species == sp)
    lab_sp <- label_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$species == sp)

    ggplot2::ggplot(
      df_sp,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$age, y = .data$height, group = .data$si)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = lab_sp,
        ggplot2::aes(label = .data$si),
        size = 2.2,
        hjust = -0.15,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(0, age_max),
        breaks = seq(0, age_max, by = 25),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = sp,
        x = x_axis_label,
        y = "Top height (m)"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  })

  if (n_panels > n_species) {
    species_plots <- c(
      species_plots,
      replicate(n_panels - n_species, patchwork::plot_spacer(), simplify = FALSE)
    )
  }

  p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(species_plots, ncol = facet_ncol)

  list(plot = p, n_rows = n_rows, n_species = n_species)
}

plot_lafleche_examples <- function(curve_set, facet_ncol = 4) {
  curve_set <- match.arg(curve_set, c("potential", "observed"))

  example_keys <- tibble::tribble(
    ~species,     ~ecological_region, ~ecological_subregion, ~ecological_type, ~label,
    "ABIE.BAL",   "3c",               NA_character_,         "MJ12",           "ABIE.BAL",
    "PICE.GLA",   "2a",               NA_character_,         "MJ11",           "PICE.GLA",
    "THUJ.OCC",   "4f",               NA_character_,         "RS12",           "THUJ.OCC",
    "ABIE.BAL",   "5e",               "5eT",                 "MS22",           "ABIE.BAL (5eT)"
  )

  ages <- seq(1, 150, by = 1)
  grid <- tidyr::expand_grid(example_id = seq_len(nrow(example_keys)), age = ages) |>
    dplyr::left_join(
      dplyr::mutate(example_keys, example_id = seq_len(dplyr::n())),
      by = "example_id"
    )

  pred <- si_lafleche2013(
    age = grid$age,
    species = grid$species,
    ecological_region = grid$ecological_region,
    ecological_type = grid$ecological_type,
    ecological_subregion = grid$ecological_subregion,
    curve_set = curve_set
  )

  plot_data <- dplyr::bind_cols(grid, pred)
  label_data <- plot_data |>
    dplyr::group_by(.data$label) |>
    dplyr::slice_max(.data$age, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()

  species_plots <- lapply(example_keys$label, function(sp) {
    df_sp <- plot_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$label == sp)
    lab_sp <- label_data |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$label == sp)

    ggplot2::ggplot(
      df_sp,
      ggplot2::aes(x = .data$age, y = .data$height)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_line(linewidth = 0.6, color = "black") +
      ggplot2::geom_text(
        data = lab_sp,
        ggplot2::aes(label = sprintf("IQS %.2f", .data$si)),
        size = 2.2,
        hjust = -0.15,
        color = "black"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
        limits = c(0, 150),
        breaks = seq(0, 150, by = 25),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, 0.08))
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        title = sp,
        x = "Breast-height age (years)",
        y = "Top height (m)"
      ) +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 10)
  })

  p <- patchwork::wrap_plots(species_plots, ncol = facet_ncol)

  list(plot = p, n_rows = 1L, n_species = nrow(example_keys))
}

reg <- CanadaForestAllometry:::si_model_registry_species() |>
  dplyr::arrange(.data$engine, .data$model_id)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(reg))) {
  x <- reg[i, , drop = FALSE]
  first_variant <- i == 1L || x$engine[[1]] != reg$engine[[i - 1L]]
  multiple_variants <- sum(reg$engine == x$engine[[1]]) > 1L
  ref_fun_link <- paste0("[`", x$engine, "()`](../reference/", x$engine, ".html)")
  if (first_variant) {
    cat("## `", x$engine[[1]], "()`\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("- Function reference: ", ref_fun_link, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if (multiple_variants) {
    variant_label <- switch(
      x$model_id[[1]],
      huang2026 = "Non-climate",
      huang2026_climate = "Climate-sensitive",
      paste0("`", x$model_id[[1]], "`")
    )
    cat("### ", variant_label, "\n\n", sep = "")
  }

  coverage <- if (any(x$province_scope[[1]] == "ALL")) {
    "Canada (all provinces/territories)"
  } else {
    paste(x$province_scope[[1]], collapse = ", ")
  }

  species_cov <- if (length(x$species[[1]]) == 0L) {
    "unknown"
  } else {
    paste(x$species[[1]], collapse = ", ")
  }

  age_basis_text <- switch(
    x$age_basis[[1]],
    total_age = "Total age",
    breast_height_age = "Breast-height age",
    x$age_basis[[1]]
  )

  description_text <- x$description[[1]]

  cat("- Model ID: `", x$model_id[[1]], "`\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Description: ", description_text, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Reference: ", x$reference[[1]], "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Age type: ", age_basis_text, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Coverage: ", coverage, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("- Species coverage: ", species_cov, "\n", sep = "")
  cat("\n", sep = "")

  if (!isTRUE(x$supports_predict_height[[1]]) || isTRUE(x$requires_gi[[1]])) {
    cat("_No height curve graphic is available for this variant._\n\n")
    cat("\n\n")
    next
  }

  scenarios <- list(default = NULL)
  if (identical(x$model_id[[1]], "huang2026")) {
    cat(
      "The default, separately fitted non-climate model uses height index at ",
      "50 years **total age**. Heights describe dominant/codominant trees, ",
      "not a standardized plot mean of the largest-DBH stems. ",
      "Ages above 180 years warn about extrapolation; ambiguous inversions are rejected.\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }
  if (identical(x$model_id[[1]], "huang2026_climate")) {
    cat(
      "Climate inputs are explicit, pre-aggregated values. `MAP` (mm) and ",
      "`MWMT` (degrees C; not mean annual temperature) exclude the current year: ",
      "use the previous 20 years for aspen, white spruce, balsam poplar and balsam fir; ",
      "10 years for black spruce; and all previous years since initiation for ",
      "lodgepole pine, Douglas-fir and jack pine. For young trees, use only ",
      "previous years since initiation, without silently omitting missing history. ",
      "`MAP_normal` and `MWMT_normal` are location-specific **1961-1990 normals**, ",
      "kept fixed between scenarios.\n\n",
      "Curve labels are **inherent HI**, so realized height at age 50 is `C * HI`. ",
      "Equal HI does not mean equal realized height across scenarios. ",
      "The climate fit at `C = 1` differs from the separately fitted non-climate model. ",
      "These dominant/codominant-height curves evaluate fixed-climate points, ",
      "**not changing-climate annual trajectories**; continuous projection ",
      "would require re-anchoring HI at each step and is not implemented here.\n\n",
      "The illustrative normals below are the species-specific reference values ",
      "used in Tables A33-A40 of the report, **not provincial defaults**. ",
      "The second scenario has 10% lower `MAP` and 1 degree C higher `MWMT`, ",
      "with normals unchanged. Neither scenario represents an observed site ",
      "or a forecast.\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
    normals <- tibble::tribble(
      ~species, ~MAP_normal, ~MWMT_normal,
      "POPU.TRE", 500, 15.5,
      "PICE.GLA", 500, 15,
      "PINU.CON", 625, 14,
      "PICE.MAR", 550, 15,
      "POPU.BAL", 550, 15,
      "ABIE.BAL", 625, 14,
      "PSEU.MEN", 625, 14.5,
      "PINU.BAN", 450, 16.5
    )
    cat(knitr::kable(normals), sep = "\n")
    cat("\n\n")
    scenarios <- list(
      at_normals = dplyr::mutate(normals, MAP = MAP_normal, MWMT = MWMT_normal),
      warmer_drier = dplyr::mutate(
        normals, MAP = 0.9 * MAP_normal, MWMT = MWMT_normal + 1
      )
    )
    cat(
      "For example, the aspen point predictions in Section 4.1 use:\n\n",
      "```r\nsi_huang2026(\n",
      "  age = c(20, 50, 80), si = 16, species = \"POPU.TRE\",\n",
      "  MAP = 400, MWMT = 18, MAP_normal = 500, MWMT_normal = 15.5,\n",
      "  variant = \"climate\"\n)\n```\n\n",
      sep = ""
    )
  }

  for (scenario in names(scenarios)) {
    if (length(scenarios) > 1L) {
      scenario_label <- switch(
        scenario,
        at_normals = "Climate averages equal the reference normals",
        warmer_drier = "Warmer/drier: MAP 10% lower, MWMT 1 degree C higher"
      )
      cat("#### ", scenario_label, "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
    if (identical(x$engine[[1]], "si_lafleche2013")) {
      curve_set <- x$fixed_args[[1]]$curve_set
      cat(
        "This model uses fixed ecological-site curves rather than arbitrary site-index levels. ",
        "The figure below shows selected example combinations of species and ecological keys ",
        "for the ", curve_set, " curve set.\n\n",
        sep = ""
      )

      plot_out <- plot_lafleche_examples(curve_set = curve_set, facet_ncol = 4)
    } else {
      plot_out <- plot_si_curves(
        model_row = x,
        si_values = c(5, 10, 15, 20, 25),
        age_min = 1,
        age_max = 150,
        age_by = 1,
        subregion = "All",
        climate = scenarios[[scenario]],
        facet_ncol = 4
      )
    }

    p <- plot_out$plot +
      patchwork::plot_annotation(
        title = x$model_id[[1]],
        subtitle = if (length(scenarios) > 1L) scenario_label else NULL
      )

    fig_dir <- knitr::opts_chunk$get("fig.path")
    dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
    file_stub <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]", "-", paste(x$model_id[[1]], scenario, sep = "-"))
    fig_file <- file.path(fig_dir, paste0("si-curves-", file_stub, ".png"))
    fig_file_out <- gsub("\\\\", "/", fig_file)

    row_height <- 2.3
    fig_h <- max(2.8, row_height * plot_out$n_rows)

    ggplot2::ggsave(
      filename = fig_file,
      plot = p,
      width = 10,
      height = fig_h,
      dpi = 140,
      bg = "white"
    )

    cat("![](", fig_file_out, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    cat("\n\n")
  }
}
```
